Refund a charge at its payment source, which must implement refunds; Voidhash records the refund it
answers with. Asks first; --yes skips that.

Usage:
  voidhash provider refund [source] [flags]

Arguments:
  source  The payment source: its slug, name or id

Flags:
      --amount <amount>    Refund only this much, such as 10.00, with --currency (default: all that
                           is left)
      --currency <code>    ISO 4217 code, such as EUR
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --reason <reason>    Why, passed to the source
      --transaction <id>   The charge's id at the source
  -y, --yes                Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider refund paddle --transaction txn_123
  voidhash provider refund paddle --transaction txn_123 --amount 10.00 --currency EUR --reason "partial outage" --yes
